stem:
Diya compares the calendar for year Y with the calendar for year Z. She wants to reuse year Y's calendar in year Z.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: Matching only one date's weekday is enough to reuse the whole calendar.
Year Y's calendar can be reused when every date falls on the same weekday in year Z.
Year Y's calendar can be reused when all dates and days match exactly across the year.
The calendar can be reused because year Z is written with larger digits than year Y.

teacher.key_rationale: A reusable calendar needs every date-to-weekday match across the year. One date alone omits the rest. Larger printed digits are a surface feature, not the calendar match.
